name: onboarding-flow
title: Onboarding Flow
description: A paged welcome flow over an aurora: cascading titles, parallax illustrations, a stretching progress pill.

perf.budget: One shader background plus the visible slide. Paging, parallax and the progress pill are scroll-driven worklets; nothing runs on the JS thread while swiping.

a11y.reducedMotion: Titles appear without cascading and the background holds still (handled by Word Cascade and Aurora Veil). Paging is user-driven, so it stays.
a11y.screenReader: Only the current slide is exposed. The progress dots read as "Step 2 of 3". Skip is hidden on the last slide.
a11y.touchTarget: Skip and the main button are at least 44 pt; the main button spans the width.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add onboarding-flow`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
